text:
Noah: Quick poll — who wants scones from the bakery at 11:30? I can grab 6.
Priya: yes please! Blueberry x2. Also can someone check the paper filter stash? Coffee is tasting off.
Eli: I'll take a plain scone and will check filters. We have 6 left in cabinet A.
Noah: tally: blueberry x2, plain x1. Any dietary needs?
Priya: gluten-free no, thanks. Could we also get oat creamer? The carton in fridge leaked.
snack-bot: Fridge inventory: Oat creamer: 0, Whole milk: 1L, Filters in Cabinet A: 6, Coffee beans: 12% remaining.
Noah: grabbing oat creamer and filters too. Total will be $9 each if anyone wants to Venmo.
Eli: leaving $9 in the tin.
Priya: sent $9. Thanks! Also leaving a sticky note on the creamer slot: "Oat creamer next to decaf" :memo:
OpsBot: Reminder: Kitchen supplies purchased by Ops should be logged in the supplies sheet: https://docs.redwood.infer/supplies.
Noah: back — scones hot, creamer in fridge, new filters in Cabinet A. Please put used scone boxes in recycling.
Priya: champion level scone procurement. :clap:
Noah: you're welcome. If anyone wants the last scone it's on the counter.
